display_name: MiniMax · H3 / Hailuo 视觉生成

alignment_instructions.i2va: For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.
alignment_instructions.fl2va: How the reference pictures align with the target video — Picture 1 (from [Shot 1]) aligns with the 0.00-second mark of the target video; Picture 2 (from [Shot 1]) aligns with the {duration:.2f}-second mark of the target video.
alignment_instructions.l2va: How the reference pictures align with the target video — <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) aligns with the {duration:.2f}-second mark of the target video.

structure.soundscape_fallback: Quiet ambient room tone with subtle environmental texture.
structure.guidance: 按 MiniMax H3 官方提示词指南（Context-IR 结构）组织：首行为参考图对齐指令（关键帧任务），正文为沿时间线展开的 integrated_multimodal_description，随后是 overall_soundscape 与 non_diegetic_music 两个声场段落。结构标记原样保留，叙事内容保持原文语言。

camera_vocabulary.slow_push: the camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed
camera_vocabulary.tracking: the camera holds a tracking shot following the subject
camera_vocabulary.orbit: the camera arcs around the subject
camera_vocabulary.static: the camera holds a static shot
camera_vocabulary.dolly_zoom: the camera zooms in while pulling out

negative_policy.guidance: H3 时间线结构提示词不使用独立负面字段；负面项仅在供应商支持独立参数时随请求携带，不并入结构化正文。

platform_prompt_guidance: MiniMax H3 专属：提示词采用 Context-IR 时间线结构；镜头运动写成自然英文动作句（运动类型 + 幅度 + 速度），不堆叠标签；说话人使用 (S1)/(S2) 稳定 ID，对白原文置于 <d>[语言标签] ...</d> 内；多镜头以 [Shot N] At 00:03.500 递增切点标注。
special_rules: 关键帧任务（I2VA/FL2VA/L2VA）的对齐指令必须是提示词第一行，其后空一行再进入正文
对白逐字保留原文与标点，不翻译不改写；画外音须注明 lips remain closed
overall_soundscape 只写环境声、动作声与非语言人声，不重复对白与配乐
non_diegetic_music 只写乐器、速度、节奏与力度变化，不用抽象情绪词；无配乐写 N/A
参考素材上限：图片 ≤ 9 张、视频 ≤ 3 段、音频 ≤ 3 段，合计文件 ≤ 12 个（H3 Ref2VA）
屏幕内可见文字使用英文双引号原样包裹
